title: Audit 20 tables against their schema (non-code, rubric-scored)
prompt: /workspace/tables holds 20 CSV tables from our shop's warehouse, and /workspace/SCHEMA.md gives each column's rules and the kinds of defect. Audit every table against its rules, including references between tables. Write /workspace/findings.json: a JSON array with one object per defect, {"table", "column", "kind", "rows", "note"}, where kind is one of SCHEMA.md's kind names and rows lists up to 5 one-based data row numbers (the header is not a row). Report each (table, column, kind) once. Report only real rule violations. You cannot run commands; you can compute in code mode. Reply with the number of findings.
workflowNote: job_run and a workflow's job() run in containers with Node 24 and Python, and no network.
